I'll collect intelligence for the specified 2026-07-30/31 window using X as the primary pulse and limited web verification. Starting with targeted X searches on frontier agent/MCP/coding releases and related signals.

## 1. Executive pulse
In the 2026-07-30T01:31Z–2026-07-31T07:31Z window, the dominant signals were OpenAI’s GPT-5.6 Luna/Terra price cuts (reflected in Codex/ChatGPT Work usage), continued traction for the official Codex plugin inside Claude Code, discussion of the just-released MCP 2026-07-28 spec (stateless core, tasks, elicitation, MCP Apps), new/niche MCP servers (Polymet design, coding-tools, memory), Copilot CLI v1.0.77 hardening, and Figma MCP × Cursor experiments for frontend handoff. AEO/GEO chatter remains mostly promotional; local SEO stays a practical lead source. Evidence quality is mixed—official blogs and maintainer posts strongest; many X claims are unbenchmarked or low-engagement.[1](https://openai.com/index/previewing-gpt-5-6-sol/)

**Observed vs inference**: Price cuts and MCP spec are confirmed via official sources. Cross-agent plugins and design MCPs show builder interest but lack broad reproducible benchmarks in-window. Uncertainty high on enterprise readiness and long-term maintenance of third-party MCPs.

## 2. High-signal findings
- **OpenAI GPT-5.6 pricing**: Luna cut ~80%, Terra ~20%; Sol unchanged. Usage accounting updated in Codex and ChatGPT Work so the same subscription yields more tokens. Faster Sol option noted.[2](https://www.threads.com/@stockstoearn/post/DbbaiqaAS-B/just-in-open-ai-cuts-prices-for-two-of-its-ai-models-gpt-terra-and-gpt-luna-as)
- **MCP 2026-07-28 spec**: Major revision (stateless core, multi-round-trip, header routing, cacheable lists, auth hardening, extensions, Tasks, Elicitation, MCP Apps). SDKs and early adopters (Flama, AWS AgentCore Gateway) shipping compliance. Breaking changes expected.[3](https://blog.modelcontextprotocol.io/posts/2026-07-28/)
- **Codex ↔ Claude Code bridge**: Official OpenAI plugin (MCP-based) provides `/codex:review`, adversarial review, rescue/transfer, multi-agent launch. Enables dual-subscription workflows and sub-agents. High engagement Spanish-language explainer.[4](https://x.com/FaztTech/status/2082977406487253008)
- **GitHub Copilot CLI v1.0.77**: Browser/web OAuth default, force-login flags, Ctrl+G editor for prompts, sandbox/MDM policy enforcement, reasoning-effort defaults.[5](https://x.com/GHCopilotLog/status/2082975800165376205)
- **Design/agent MCPs**: Polymet MCP (one-line add for project spin-up, generations, bidirectional file/diff/asset flow with coding agents). Figma MCP × Cursor experiments for responsive HP builds. Custom SolidWorks MCP demos.[6](https://x.com/polymetai/status/2082868918402658509)
- **Orchestration**: Brigade (`brigade mcp sync/verify`, skill promotion/rollback, bounded task dispatch with receipts). Coding Tools MCP (read/edit/run/test primitives). Zep memory plugin for Claude/Codex/Cursor.[7](https://x.com/brigadeclaw/status/2082972676167987429)
- **Other**: DeepSeek-V4-Flash free tier on ZenMux (Codex-optimized benchmarks claimed). Registry malware analysis ongoing (lower than expected). SKI voice coding tool launch (Product Hunt). MCP enterprise/K8s maturity narrative.[8](https://x.com/ZenMuxAI/status/2083091208658989497)

Low-engagement or unverified: many “new MCP” announcements, generic AEO pitches.

## 3. Consumer taste and demographic signals
Sparse high-quality signals in-window. 
- **Anti-generic-AI aesthetics**: Explicit “built by people, for people” claims and pride in non-AI origin for consumer-facing hubs (collectibles/UI). Suggests buyer fatigue with obvious AI slop.[9](https://x.com/yotdog69/status/2082953385582448703)
- **Local-service buyers**: Persistent “plumber near me”/Maps ranking emphasis as cheapest high-intent lead; 2 AM urgency language. 
- **AEO/GEO awareness**: Rising “if ChatGPT isn’t recommending you, you’re invisible” framing vs classic SEO; HubSpot tool comparisons (AEO vs Otterly/Profound/Semrush). Mostly agency marketing.[10](https://x.com/TechSlideITS/status/2083092832697409584)
- **Onboarding/retention**: Indirect—preference for evidence chains, clickable prototypes, and human-crafted micro-interactions over pure chatbot forms (criticism of “AI assistant that is just a slower form”). 
- **Inference (low confidence)**: Local-service and SMB buyers still prioritize Maps parity, trust signals, and fast mobile conversion; creator/consumer taste favors authentic/real imagery and craft over polished AI defaults. Conflicting: heavy AI-tool promotion continues unabated.

No strong Gen-Z/millennial demographic data or buying-language corpora surfaced.

## 4. Agent, MCP, skill, GitHub, and workflow opportunities
**High relevance to Dillon OS stack (Claude/Codex/Cursor-centric, frontend/full-stack, site factory)**:
- Cross-provider review/rescue via Codex plugin: parallel supervisory loops, reduced sycophancy for code review/refactor/debug. 
- MCP 2026-07-28: future-proof servers (stateless = easier K8s/Netlify-like deploys); watch Tasks/Elicitation/MCP Apps for orchestration and UI generation. 
- Polymet + Figma MCPs: design-to-code handoff, component generation, asset sync—directly maps to planning/handoff and avoiding generic aesthetics. 
- Copilot CLI updates: better auth and sandbox for CI-like or parallel agent use. 
- Brigade/Coding Tools/Zep: skill/MCP sync, bounded tasks, memory, safe edit/test primitives—supports maker-checker, deterministic gates, repo navigation. 
- Price cuts: cheaper Luna/Terra routing for high-volume factory work (component gen, QA, FAQ drafting).

**Compatibility notes**: Prefer official/maintainer sources. Assess prompt-injection (MCP tool descriptions), secrets (OAuth/variable refs only), context cost (list caching helps), overlap (many coding MCPs duplicate shell/file tools). No install during research.

**Source quality**: Official OpenAI/MCP blogs and GitHub highest; X demos medium (reproducible but unbenchmarked); directories/viral lists low.

## 5. Website factory, design, AEO, and retention implications
- **25-site factory**: Figma/Polymet MCP + Cursor/Claude for vertical templates and real-imagery handoff; Brigade-style sync for skills across harnesses; browser/Playwright MCPs (mentioned in resource lists) for visual regression, a11y, responsive QA, Maps-to-site parity checks. Source-ready FAQs + AEO trust gates (structured data, clear authorship) become more critical as GEO rises. Safe Netlify previews remain ideal for approval gates. 
- **Design/UI/UX craft**: Push real-image art direction and micro-interactions; avoid generic AI look via human critique loops and design-system tokens. Storybook-compatible component gen via agents. 
- **AEO/SEO/retention**: Technical SEO + load-bearing structure still foundational (per SEO veterans). Local SEO/Maps parity high-ROI for service clients. Evidence-chain prototypes and third-visit retention (clear offers, lifecycle hooks) over pure chat UIs. CRO via faster mobile conversion and trust signals. 
- **Operational**: Maker-checker via dual-model review (Claude write → Codex review); independent visual critique; deterministic acceptance (Playwright suites, Lighthouse, a11y audits).

Uncertainty: exact a11y/performance gains from new MCPs unmeasured here.

## 6. Recommended experiments ranked by expected benefit, evidence strength, risk, deterministic acceptance test, independent checker, and rollback
1. **Sandbox-test Codex plugin for Claude Code** (highest benefit for review/refactor loops). Evidence: official repo + demos. Risk: medium (dual-sub cost, context). Acceptance: run `/codex:review` on 3 known PRs; measure defect catch rate vs baseline. Checker: human diff review. Rollback: disable plugin. 
2. **Sandbox-test Polymet MCP + Figma MCP with Cursor/Claude** for one vertical template. Evidence: maintainer one-line install + builder posts. Risk: medium (asset leakage, style drift). Acceptance: generate responsive component set; Playwright visual + a11y pass; human craft score > baseline AI. Checker: independent designer. Rollback: remove MCP. 
3. **Watch/save MCP 2026-07-28 compliance patterns** (Flama/AWS examples) and price-cut routing (Luna for bulk factory). Evidence: official spec. Risk: low (read-only). Acceptance: n/a yet. 
4. **Sandbox-test Copilot CLI v1.0.77 sandbox/MDM features** in isolated CI-like loop. Evidence: release notes. Risk: low-medium. Acceptance: login + policy enforce on sample task. 

Prefer these 2–4 testable items over tool sprawl. No production, no credentials, no outreach.

## 7. Watchlist and rejected hype
**Watchlist**: Full MCP 2026-07-28 migration guides and Tier-1 SDK stability; Brigade skill promotion; DeepSeek-V4-Flash Codex benchmarks; SKI voice; ongoing MCP registry security audits; AEO tool maturation (HubSpot comparisons); enterprise K8s MCP stories. 

**Rejected hype / no-action**: Viral “54 tools / Claude Bible” lists (duplicative, unvetted); generic AEO agency pitches without data; unbenchmarked custom MCPs (SolidWorks, Kingfisher, etc.) with unclear maintenance/security; “MCP will eat all SaaS” claims; low-signal plugin deals or laptop launches; any tool requiring broad permissions or secret exfiltration risk. Duplicated coding primitives already covered by core agents. Insecure or high context-cost directories.

**What Dillon OS should change today** (≤5 evidence-backed):
1. Route bulk/low-stakes factory tasks (FAQ drafts, component variants, initial QA) toward cheaper Luna/Terra tiers now that usage accounting updated. 
2. Add dual-model review pattern (Claude primary + Codex plugin review) to maker-checker checklist for code and content. 
3. Prototype one Figma/Polymet MCP handoff in a sandbox vertical template to tighten design-to-code and real-imagery flow. 
4. Track MCP 2026-07-28 server compatibility as a gate for any new MCP additions (prefer stateless/auth-hardened). 
5. Strengthen AEO trust gates (authorship, structured FAQs, Maps parity) on all new sites given rising GEO framing.

**No action**: Install nothing; ignore unverified MCP spam, pure-hype GEO threads, and tools overlapping existing Cursor/Claude/Copilot capabilities without clear deterministic upside.
